name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2019
  6:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

NATIONAL ANTHEM – TAYLOR FURLONG

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card and give that
card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting. Please
observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of Staff and/or other
issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

OUTGOING MAYOR’S PROGRAM
  1. PRESENTATIONS TO OUTGOING MAYOR, TONY LIMA

  2. COMMENTS FROM OUTGOING MAYOR, TONY LIMA

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS
This is the time for the public to address the City Council on any item of interest within the
subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council that could not be heard under public
comment section at the beginning of the meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for additional general comments, announcements, and requests of Staff
and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this
time.

ADJOURNMENT
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.
minutes_text:
CITY OF ARTESIA
  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2019
  6:00P.M.
The Special Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 6:00 p.m., on Monday,
December 9, 2019 in the Albert O. Little Community Center by Mayor Tony Lima. The National
Anthem was led by Taylor Furlong.

 PRESENT:  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Rene Trevino, Councilmember
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Miguel Canales, Mayor Pro Tem
  Tony Lima, Mayor

 ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Christi Hogin, City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistance City Clerk
  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager
  Siamlu Cox, Acting Finance Manager

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO APPROVE THE AGENDA.

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER CANALES.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Trevino, Canales, Taj and Lima
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 5-0-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS

  City Clerk presented the Announcement Regarding Speaker Cards.

  Lynda Johnson, Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors, provided public comments.

  Hideki Maemoto, Rotary Club of Cerritos-Artesia, provided public comments.

  Naresh Solanki, City of Cerritos, provided public comments.

  Dave Sprengel, Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department, provided public comments.

  Page 1 of 2
 COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

OUTGOING MAYOR’S PROGRAM

  1. PRESENTATIONS TO OUTGOING MAYOR, TONY LIMA

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales presented certificate of recognition to Mayor Lima.

  Certificates of recognition on behalf of various state and local representatives were
  presented.

  2. COMMENTS FROM OUTGOING MAYOR, TONY LIMA

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS

  There were no additional public comments.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

  Mayor Lima provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Taj adjourned the meeting at 7:00 pm.

  Page 2 of 2
